file_purpose: Replication record for saved IDMT-Traffic runs. Metrics are copied from the eval JSON files in this checkout. train_time_seconds is null because those files do not store duration.
experiment_name: IDMT direction, weather, vehicle, physics, fusion, and transfer

dataset.name: IDMT-Traffic
dataset.default_filters: SE microphone, channel pair CH34, for the EUSIPCO setting.

split.eusipco: Official train/test lists. Validation is 10% of train events, split by event_id, seed 42 where a saved run_config says so.
split.weather_site: Train and test on Schleusinger-Allee only. Wet IDMT recordings exist only at that site, so a pooled weather split can be solved by recognizing the location.

saved_run_config_meaning: When run_config is present it is the training config saved next to the checkpoint. When it is null, this checkout has metrics but not that config. Do not fill the gap from a different run.

headline_reading.direction_3class_mel: cnn/direction/mel_3class is the mean-channel 3-class mel CNN on the EUSIPCO test list.
headline_reading.weather: cnn/weather/weather_mel_site is the site-controlled dry/wet result. cnn/weather/weather_mel is the pooled run and is not the primary weather number.
headline_reading.not_a_ctc_model: None of these runs is the position CTC ablation. That record is position_ctc/outputs/ablate/ablations.json.
